protocolNotes: OBD-II legislated (1996+). Typical link: ISO 9141-2 or KWP2000 on PCM; some trims may expose early Ford CAN — start Tier 0 OBD trunk before body/gateway work.
immoNotes: PATS era — Passive Anti-Theft System (no Stellantis SKREEM/SKIM). Tier 3 is information-only per immo-info-ford.json; no key programming in-app.
operatorSteps: Ignition ON, engine off OK for link check; connect 16-pin DLC.
Prefer USB OTG + ELM327 cable; grant USB permission when Android prompts.
Settings → transport elm327_usb or auto; Tier 0 (Native OBD) on; tiers 1–4 off for first connect.
If USB empty: pair BT ELM327 in Android Bluetooth settings, enable BLUETOOTH_CONNECT for TCW.
Android cannot install Windows CH340 drivers — use OTG + in-app USB permission or a BT dongle.
